purpose: Benchmark fixture scope for release-record reviews. The paths below are intentionally vulnerable (or intentionally trivial) TEST DATA. In a release-record review their findings are classified as expected fixture findings — preserved in the record, never blocking. Ordinary reviews without a declared fixture scope keep scanning them normally.
